title: Algebraic identity inside a prime-divisor argument

located_defect.lean_text:
def lhs (a : ℤ) : ℤ := 4 * a ^ 4 - 4 * a ^ 2 + 4
def rhs (a : ℤ) : ℤ := (2 * a - 1) ^ 2 + 3
def SourceIdentity : Prop := ∀ a : ℤ, lhs a = rhs a
def SourceIdentityInContext : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : ℤ) (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → (p : ℤ) ∣ a ^ 4 - a ^ 2 + 1 → lhs a = rhs a
located_defect.description: Stored proof-text line 0004 asserts, inside the step `p | 4a^4 - 4a^2 + 4 = (2a-1)^2 + 3, so (-3/p) = 1`, the algebraic identity 4a^4 - 4a^2 + 4 = (2a - 1)^2 + 3. Read for every integer a (SourceIdentity) and in the source's context (SourceIdentityInContext) this is the located defect. Supply the corrected right-hand side in the frozen form (α * a ^ e + β) ^ 2 + γ and prove the identity for every integer a; then prove the located sentence's divisibility conclusion (every prime p dividing a^4 - a^2 + 1 divides the corrected right-hand side). The ambient theorem of the problem (SourceGoal) is not part of this record.
